ultimates.name: Hearthfall
ultimates.blurb: Calls down a falling sun. Everything beneath it burns.

ultimates.name: Skyrend Cyclone
ultimates.blurb: A cyclone tears up the ground, lifts every foe near your target and shreds them in the air.

ultimates.name: Stormcaller's Verdict
ultimates.blurb: Bolts fall on every foe in sight, one after another, then leap between them.

ultimates.name: Mountain's Fist
ultimates.blurb: A fist of living rock bursts from the ground beneath your foe, ringed by stone spears.

ultimates.name: Leviathan Tide
ultimates.blurb: A towering wave rises behind you and breaks over everything in front.

ultimates.name: Hundred Shades
ultimates.blurb: Shade clones pour out of the smoke and strike your foe from every side at once. Any nature can learn it.
